candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-quality candidate sprite-sheet key art for a 2D side-scrolling action game, not a diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved game-camera character identity and held-katana reference (ignore the separate portrait heads); Image 2 is the approved costume/model turn-around identity (use written corrections below); Image 3 is a bare skeleton pose/timing/layout guide ONLY, never copy its lines, dots, words or colors into the final art.
Keep EXACTLY the same young adult male identity and polished hand-painted anime game art as Image 1: lean athletic approximately eight-head-tall proportions, silver-white spiky hair with a single dark-red streak on his OWN right-front fringe; grey eyes; black high-collar undershirt, black leather long coat to mid-calf with dark crimson lining, TWO HORIZONTAL silver-buckle chest straps, black belt silver buckle, black fitted trousers, dark steel knee guards and segmented shin guards, black boots. Both hands and BOTH FOREARMS wrapped dark red to elbows with bare fingers; NO metal forearm armor and NO fire.
Fixed right-facing 3/4 side game camera in every cell, face looks screen-right. Use the visible right hand for ONE-HANDED katana grip; left hand free for balance. One single shallow-curved steel katana with small round guard, black/dark-red wrapped hilt, short proportion matching Image 1; empty black scabbard stays on LEFT hip. Body and sword must follow the same physical pose.
Style: crisp deep contour, coherent cel-shaded planes with restrained painted highlights, dark leather, clean silver metal, readable at 190 px character height. Same skull size, limb lengths, costume, lighting and rendering quality throughout.
Composition: EXACTLY EIGHT separated full-body poses, four equal columns and two equal rows, read left-to-right top row then bottom row. Wide landscape sheet, generous transparent gutters. Each head, boot, coat, sword and scabbard completely inside its own cell. Consistent anatomical scale; do not stretch crouched or running figures to same bounding-box height. No duplicate final pose in the eight-frame cyclic sheets.
Background: true transparent RGBA alpha, no gray/white field, no fake checkerboard, no shadows, no floor line, no labels/numbers/grid/borders, no environment. No motion blur, slash effect, aura, glow, particles, afterimages, extra limbs or extra blades.
Primary requested action:
Natural forward WALK cycle (not a run), exactly 8 distinct phases. 1 right/near leg extended forward heel contact and left leg trailing toe support; 2 near knee flexes accepting weight, pelvis lower; 3 near leg vertical under hip, far knee swings forward passing (narrow stance, lifted foot); 4 near heel rises for push-off, far knee advances and pelvis higher; 5 far leg forward heel contact, near leg trailing; 6 far knee flexes under weight; 7 far support leg vertical, near knee swings past with lifted foot; 8 far heel pushes off, near knee advances. Obvious alternating legs with true passing poses and restrained vertical bob; no airborne double-foot flight phase. Torso calm and upright, coat tails lag. Right hand calmly keeps the drawn sword low behind/along the direction of travel with tip safe off ground, the sword does not swing like an attack. Left arm counter-swings gently. Follow the pose order and joint guide without changing identity.
candidates.review_note: Repeated contact/half-step, no complete alternating cycle; rejected.
